The browser demo uses these third-party components:

- Transformers.js 4.3.0, bundled in runtime.js, Apache-2.0. See TRANSFORMERS-LICENSE.
- ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0, loaded from jsDelivr, MIT.
- TurboJev Web/WASM assets are part of this repository and licensed Apache-2.0.

The ONNX Runtime Web files are fetched from the pinned jsDelivr URL in runtime.js.
The demo also fetches model files from Hugging Face after the visitor selects Load.
